discover.title: Discover possibilities
discover.description: Start with an initiative or bring something entirely your own.
discover.noneConfirmed: There are currently no confirmed real activities. Event dates are fictional demo data.
discover.interviewContext: Your proposal develops the interview initiative. Topic and format remain open.

interviews.title: Between languages and schools
interviews.description: Student interviews about identity, languages and life at different schools.
interviews.detail: Organise conversations about your relationships with languages, countries and cultures. Develop your own questions, find voluntary interview partners and discuss the format with school coordinators. Recording and publication require prior consent and editorial review. No completed interviews or confirmed participants are implied here.

workshops.title: Explore knowledge together
workshops.description: Cross-school workshops on topics that interest you.
workshops.detail: Develop a workshop, share tasks and collect interest first. The topic, location and delivery are agreed with the participating schools. The event directory contains example formats to try.

exchange.title: Discover another school day
exchange.description: A shared encounter or school visit as an exchange.
exchange.detail: Plan a meeting between student groups and discover different perspectives. School visits, supervision and possible dates still need to be agreed. There is no confirmed exchange or bookable trip.

tutoring.title: Learn from each other
tutoring.description: Non-commercial support from students for students.
tutoring.detail: Offer support or describe what you need help with. The tutoring board connects subjects, topics, languages and availability. Contact drafts and interests are stored locally only.

projects.title: There is room for your idea
projects.description: Develop your own projects without a prescribed format.
projects.detail: A creative project, experiment, social initiative or something entirely different: you choose the goals, topics and collaborators yourself. A self-selected planning status does not replace school approval.

tutoring.title: Tutoring board
tutoring.description: Find support and share knowledge voluntarily – without payments.
tutoring.subject: Subject
tutoring.validation: Please provide a subject (2–80 characters), topics (3–200), support (20–1000), availability (3–200) and at least one language.
tutoring.localHint: Fictional listings and local demo. No school referral, payments or public contact details.
tutoring.contactHint: This text is saved in this browser only. It is not sent. Please do not enter phone numbers, addresses or other personal contact details.
tutoring.contactValidation: Please enter a draft with 10 to 600 characters.
tutoring.matchHint: Opposite listings with the same subject, a shared language and a compatible format. Availability and exact topics still need to be agreed together.
tutoring.empty: No matching listings yet. Adjust filters or create your own listing.

math-offer.description: In this demo I would like to help with understanding equations and discuss example exercises together.

math-request.description: In this demo I am looking for someone to practise linear equations with me and explain each step.

german-offer.description: In this demo I offer shared conversation practice and support with learning new words.

coding-request.description: In this demo I am looking for help with functions and would like to understand a small programme better.
coding-request.availability: Demo: online in the afternoon, date open

community.title: Community
community.description: Find collaborators and try shared exchange locally.
community.visibility: Show my fictional demo profile in the local directory
community.privacy: Directory sharing is voluntary and can be withdrawn. Your own posts and listings remain visible independently. Use fictional data only. This is not secure access control.
community.localHint: All posts stay in this browser. Switching profiles shows the same local demo; other devices receive nothing.
community.validation: Please enter 3 to 1200 characters and do not publish personal data.
community.emptyRoom: No local posts yet. Start a question or exchange.
community.reported: Demo report saved. It has not been sent to anyone.
community.backendHint: Do not share private contact details. Posts and reports in the guest demo stay in this browser; reports are not sent to anyone. If you face a real problem, speak to a trusted adult.
community.noActivity: No local community activity of your own yet.
community.projectHint: Find open projects and register interest. Project groups are organised through shared ideas here; there are no private group chats.
community.contactFree: No private messages or public personal contact details.

roomDescriptions.general: Questions about school life and new perspectives.
roomDescriptions.learning: Learning questions, experiences and mutual support.

project.topicHint: Optional: up to eight comma-separated topics, each at most 40 characters. No category is required.
project.freeHint: Your project does not have to fit a predefined format. Goals and collaborators are optional; no school approval is granted here.
project.validation: Please respect the length limits for goals, collaborators and topics.
